variants.name: user-isolation-verification
variants.description: Deterministic verification receipt for verified-user thread, memory, and knowledge isolation

notes: All eight OpenSpec tasks are complete and strict validation exits 0.
The focused two-JWT server-full case covers direct and ACP thread-adjacent sessions/runs, configuration/policy, memory, knowledge bases, and documents with same-user controls and cross-user denials.
SurrealKV and PostgreSQL 17 both preserve equal logical knowledge IDs for two owners; PostgreSQL rejects a cross-owner parent foreign key.
Legacy SurrealKV sessions remain anonymous and cannot be claimed by an authenticated ID lookup.
The final candidate's existing Clippy baseline emits 572 warnings; no warning-free claim is made.
